evidence: At 360x780 the document scrollWidth is 960 CSS px against a 360 px client width. .s-content measures 960 px wide and the page can be scrolled about 600 px sideways; screenshots show the right side of every paragraph, code block and component cut off at the 360 px edge.
fix: Constrain the docs layout at narrow widths: make .s-content/.container full-width (width:100%; max-width:100%) and remove the fixed 960 px flex basis, so the content column reflows inside the viewport.

evidence: The fixed sidebar navigation (.s-nav, x=30, width=210, height=1950) is painted over the document text at 360 px. In the top screenshots 'GETTING STARTED', 'Accordions', 'Element 1' and other nav labels sit directly on top of the Accordions/Autocomplete body copy and code blocks.
fix: Collapse the sidebar off-canvas below 600 px and expose it through a menu toggle, or hide .s-nav at that breakpoint; do not keep the fixed 210 px nav visible over the content column.

evidence: Each of the six KPI tiles is 120 px wide. 'Total Collections' and 'Total Connections' render as 'Total Collect...' and 'Total Conne...' and every 'From last Week' delta renders as 'From last ...'; the Total Connections label box extends to x=377 in the 360 px viewport.
fix: Let the KPI labels and delta text wrap, or reduce the tile font size/padding at the xs breakpoint. Remove the single-line ellipsis so the metric name stays readable.

evidence: The 17 px 'Top Campaign Performance' heading has a 191 px content box and 213 px scroll width with overflow hidden and nowrap; the rendered heading stops at 'Top Campaign Perfor...'.
fix: Allow the heading to wrap inside the 318 px panel at narrow widths (white-space: normal; overflow: visible) or shorten it for the xs breakpoint.
